title: fix: #6050 hide the block button while scrolling
issueTitle: [Bug] Block button is repositioned on every scroll event, causing layout and hit-test work while scrolling
why: The report is about layout and hit-test work done during scrolling, which is a performance and timing problem that shows up only in a DevTools profile; it does not say which visible result is correct, since either suggested fix (hiding the button or moving it with the content) would be acceptable.
